title: A divisor of an odd-index Pell sum
summary: Sum the first n + 1 odd-index Pell numbers. The Pell number at index n + 1 divides this sum.

tasks.title: Count by the last square
tasks.claim: ∀ n : ℕ, 2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), pell (2 * k + 1)) = pell (2 * n + 2)
tasks.role: Turns the sum into half of a single Pell number.
tasks.context: A board of odd length 2n+1 must contain a square. Its last square is in cell 2k+1, has two colors, and is followed solely by dominoes. The prefix contributes P(2k+1). Alternatively, apply the recurrence P(j+2) = 2P(j+1) + P(j) and telescope the even indices.

tasks.title: Cut the tiling at the midpoint
tasks.claim: ∀ n : ℕ, pell (2 * n + 2) = 2 * (pell (n + 1) * (pell (n + 1) + pell n))
tasks.role: Provides an explicit multiple of twice the required divisor.
tasks.context: Cut the length-2n+1 board after n cells. A clean cut contributes P(n+1)P(n+2). A crossing domino contributes P(n)P(n+1), which is zero at n = 0. Add the terms and use P(n+2) = 2P(n+1) + P(n).
